newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up on spread buying but undertone soft.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up on spread buying but undertone soft.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude prices rose on sporadic buying on Thursday afternoon ahead of the expiry of the prompt month contract in five days, but brokers said the undertone remained weak.
"Its mostly sporadic buying on the spread, nothing big. But the undertone remained weak and is held up temporarily by the spread," one broker said.
"The May contract will also expire in five days and players are rolling over their positions."
May last traded at $17.80 per barrel, up five cents from the previous close in London after registering 109 lots. It hit a day's high of $17.83 earlier.
June last traded at $18.05 per barrel up five cents, after recording 135 lots.
Brokers had earlier indicated the support for May at $17.00 and the next support at $16.80.

They said the after-hours ACCESS trading system recovered marginally, having last traded for May at $19.18, down nine cents per barrel. May had traded at a low of $19.08 and there were concerns that it could test the $19.00-support.
